title: Chapter 950
paragraphs: Chapter 950
Episode 234. To Hell (10)
'I should have said from the start that I would go with him. With Jin Runcandel who ascended to the Divine and Kelliark Zipfel there, what was I thinking, letting him go alone...!'
As Elona moved, the Tower of Stories vibrated. The tower resonated with her anger.
Most of the people residing in the tower dared not raise their heads to look at Elona, due to the overwhelming pressure of all the magic energy in the vicinity being concentrated.
"…Elona, I too am worried about the head of the family. However, for now, please calm your energy."
Lonil, the only executive who stood in front of Elona, opened his mouth.
"Lord Lonil."
"The magicians of our family are falling. If you leave, they will all become people who must prepare for the attacks of other forces, including the enemy tribes."
Lonil was speaking the absolute truth.

However, Elona felt some inexplicable disappointment at Lonil's business-like attitude. She thought that for Lonil, the most important thing was the 'Zipfel' family, not Veradin, even though Veradin valued him as a confidant.
Looking back, it was obvious that everyone in the family was like that.
"…It becomes clear."
Elona spoke as she retracted her energy.
"May I ask what has become clear?"
"The family is precious to me. However, the head of the family, is even more precious. I am aware that I am an immature human. I'm sorry, but I must go."
Lonil bowed his head.

"There's nothing to apologize to us for. Besides, it's not just your decision, the head of the family directly sent a signal through Hroti, didn't he? We will defend the mainland well. Salrion is here, go with him to Grosh Castle."
"Understood."
When Elona ascended to the top floor of the tower, the dragon Salrion was already prepared to fly, having returned to his original form.
[Octavia had me wait here in case something like this happened.]
Salrion said as he soared into the sky.
"I see."

[Unlike the others, Octavia believes that for the current Zipfel to continue, Veradin is absolutely necessary. And I don't know how this will sound to you, but Octavia cherishes Veradin very much on a personal level. Just like you.]
Salrion had accurately read Elona's psychology. Although she felt a little embarrassed that her true feelings were revealed, she wasn't displeased to hear it.
"That's a relief. I......I'm not sure, Salrion. There are times when I often feel like the chief is not the ruler of Zipfel, but just a puppet that looks like a ruler."

[Zipfel is originally that kind of family. Either the chief makes everyone a puppet, or everyone makes the chief a puppet. In fact, it's not just a problem with Zipfel. All power groups in the world are constituted like that.]
"I guess so."
[Moreover, after becoming the chief, Veradin swung an iron fist and carried out a purge. Everyone fears him, so how can he be a puppet?]
The reason Elona felt that way about Veradin was none other than this.

Because she knew that Veradin's current state was not a result he had arrived at of his own volition. Therefore, those who assisted Veradin as his closest aides were most deeply involved in his mental manipulation.
However, Elona did not know the details of the mental manipulation experiment.

Veradin spared words about mental manipulation so that Elona would not despise the chiefs. It was a judgment that it would not help the family at all if the relationship between Elona and them twisted.
'The recent chief was definitely changing. He seemed to be shaken by something, yearning for something.'
Elona had been hoping that more of Veradin's human aspects would be revealed.
If he continues to ignore them, she had a premonition that Veradin would eventually become a monster that exists solely for Zipfel, just like his past self.
'I will do whatever it takes to prevent the chief from becoming like I was a thousand years ago, even if it hinders the prosperity of the family.'
She felt a burning inside. Despite Salrion speeding up to the point of making his breathing rough, Groshae Castle felt distant.
Bad thoughts kept popping up. Maybe Veradin might already be dead.
[We're almost there.]
Around sunset, Groshae Castle began to come into view.
Most of the fleets and troops of various factions that had been waiting at Groshae Castle were in hell, but some of the golden ships and a part of Runcandel's fleet were still left.

The golden ship was guarding the entrance of hell in formation. The alliance knew about Elona's movement not long after Salrion left the Tower of Story, after receiving a report from an unknown person.
[Elona, they knew we were coming.]
Salrion said in a tense voice.
Suddenly, if the alliance is thinking of attacking the Lutero Federation, now might be a good time.
While Zipfel's chief and the most important fleet of the family had all gone on an expedition to hell, only Jin's group had left the alliance.
Of course, there was Elona, the strongest celestial magician of Zipfel, but the alliance had the overall military advantage for now.
Moreover, if the alliance had some sort of deal with the enemy tribe? Elona couldn't handle all of that on her own.
"……Let's have a conversation first."
A woman appeared at the head of the golden fleet.
"Elona Zipfel, Pungryong Salrion. Stop for a moment, I have something to discuss."
It was Luntia. Behind her, the knights of the black troop and Hedo appeared.
"Do you want to fight me?"
As Elona showed her anger, the sea area near the castle stirred.
"Do you have poor hearing? I said I have something to discuss, didn't I?"

Luntia stared straight at Elona's killing intent without blinking an eye. Even though she was not yet transcendent, she was still capable of a decent fight against Elona, and there were many such capable individuals here.
Moreover, the alliance also had the means of space jumps through the Red Owl and Motra, making it entirely possible to bring in additional forces in an instant.

"If you want to fight, I won't avoid it. But it seems like you have some urgent matter and have come here, it would be better for you to calmly participate in the conversation if you don't want to delay your task."
"……Alright, let's hear it."
"That's right. Our small lord said that if you were to come to the Gate of Hell, it would only be because Veradin Zipfel is in danger. Is that correct?"
Of course, any information about the status or condition of the lord is strictly confidential in any family.
But Elona nodded immediately. She didn't have time for word games.
"Yes. I received a support request from the Lord."
"Then we have no reason to let you in. There's nothing better for our Runcandel than the Lord of Zipfel perishing in Hell."
"You're joking with me right now...."

"Originally, that would have been the case. However, our small lord doesn't seem to want him to die just yet. I don't know if you know, but our small lord and your lord have had an extraordinary relationship in the past. It's strange, but only we are listening here."
[Hey, Luntia Runcandel, what's the sudden nonsense?]

"Dragon, it'd be better if you keep your mouth shut. Don't you know yet? If you really want to save Veradin Zipfel, you need to accept whatever we ask for. Do you want to fight us, and then go to save Veradin Zipfel? Even if we were to defeat all of us, it's clear that Lady Elona wouldn't be safe. The fight doesn't seem to be ending in a day or two."
Salrion clenched his teeth without being able to refute.
"……I understand what you mean, so please quickly state what you want."
Elona was barely keeping her voice steady. In fact, she wanted to beg them to step aside immediately.
As Luntia said, if they fought with the alliance now, the possibility of saving Veradin would be lost forever.
"Lady Elona Zipfel. If you promise us one thing on your honor, we will step aside right away."
"What's the promise?"
"If you manage to go safely to hell and rescue Veradin Zipfel, meet our record mage once and face your past."
"…What did you say?"

"The request of Runcandel is all that. Just like when Runcandel and Zipfel had secret talks in Gwigoksaeseong, let's leisurely look at the past of the Commander without ever attacking each other. It doesn't seem like such a bad condition for the Commander."
For Elona, it was a completely unexpected demand.
And as Luntia said, it was not a bad condition for Elona. Elona wanted to find her forgotten past.
Even if some horrible truth was waiting.
"That's... really all there is?"
"That's right."
Salrion hesitated, but Elona nodded as if there was no room for doubt.
"I understand. Let's do it that way."
"You're decisive. I trust you will keep the promise."
"I promise on my honor, my family, and my province. I, Elona Zipfel, will face my past by meeting Valeria Hister after safely returning from hell after rescuing the governor. However."
Elona looked around the alliance's troops.

"…If the person who endangered the governor is not the demons but true Runcandel, I will surely kill him in hell. When I come back, I will turn you all into a handful of ashes. Even if the world is completely destroyed."

"Heh, the arrogance must be due to the new power. But Commander, you don't know our sovereign. True Runcandel is not a person who can do such cowardly acts to friends. If our youngest had intended to, Veradin Zipfel would have already died several times."
Luntia shrugged her shoulders.

"If it were the old times, it would have been unthinkable. Runcandel's sovereign caring and considering Zipfel's province. Moreover, sending the enemy's new mage to the battlefield where the sovereign is to save Veradin? But our youngest Runcandel is like that. And everyone respects the youngest's will. Even beyond the laws."
In fact, she was not sure if her father in the Black Sea felt the same way, but... Luntia swallowed her words and looked at Elona.
"So now go. Runcandel will watch to see if you keep your promise well."
The golden ship ascended, opening the gates to hell.
Elona thought about Runcandel during the short time passing beneath it, on her way to the gates of hell.
There was a distinct difference between how Runcandel looked at Jin and how Zipfel looked at Veradin.
That's why Elona felt a bit strange.
Although forgotten due to a long seal, a thousand years ago, Elona had harbored the same feeling.
It was envy towards Runcandel.
